selection_process: The selection process comprises scrutiny and shortlisting of applications followed by a mock lecture before the Selection Committee constituted by the Department.

how_to_apply: Download the application format provided in the official notification PDF.
Fill out the application form with accurate details in BLOCK letters and affix a recent passport-size photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and relevant experience/training certificates.
Route the application through proper channel via the DSWO and Collector (for CDPOs) or via the CDPO and DSWO (for Supervisors).

Ensure the forwarding authority certifies the service particulars, furnishes a No Objection Certificate (NOC), and issues a certificate confirming no disciplinary or vigilance proceeding is pending or contemplated.

Send the completed application to reach the Additional Secretary to Government, Women & Child Development Department, Lok Seva Bhawan, Bhubaneswar – 751001 within 15 days from the date of publication of the notice (on or before 25 October 2026, 05:00 PM).
Send an advance copy of the application by email to [email protected] before the last date and time.
important_instructions: Applicants must have a clean service record with no disciplinary, vigilance, or criminal case pending, contemplated, or of satisfactory performance. Tenure of deputation is 3 years per term, subject to satisfactory performance, up to a maximum of 2 terms. No deputation allowance is admissible. On completion of tenure, the officer shall revert to her parent district cadre. Applications received after the last date, incomplete applications, or applications not routed through proper channel shall not be considered. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the mock lecture.

content_sections.text: The department has announced a total of 13 vacancies for deputation posts at the State Institute for Women and Child Development (SIWC), Bhubaneswar and SIWC, Barpali.

content_sections.heading: WCD Odisha Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises scrutiny and shortlisting of applications followed by a mock lecture before the Selection Committee constituted by the Department. Scrutiny and shortlisting of applications received within the due date as per the prescribed Selection Procedure and Guidelines. Delivery of a mock lecture by shortlisted candidates before the Selection Committee. The date, time, venue, and topic will be communicated separately. Overall assessment by the Selection Committee for final selection and posting.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application format provided in the official notification PDF. Fill out the application form with accurate details in BLOCK letters and affix a recent passport-size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and relevant experience/training certificates. Route the application through proper channel via the DSWO and Collector (for CDPOs) or via the CDPO and DSWO (for Supervisors). Ensure the forwarding authority certifies the service particulars, furnishes a No Objection Certificate (NOC), and issues a certificate confirming no disciplinary or vigilance proceeding is pending or contemplated. Send the completed application to reach the Additional Secretary to Government, Women & Child Development Department, Lok Seva Bhawan, Bhubaneswar – 751001 within 15 days from the date of publication of the notice (on or before 25 October 2026, 05:00 PM). Send an advance copy of the application by email to [email protected] before the last date and time.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Filled Application Format (Annexure) with a recent passport-size photograph Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Relevant experience and training certificates No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the forwarding authority Certificate regarding no disciplinary/vigilance proceeding pending or contemplated

content_sections.heading: WCD Odisha Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicants must have a clean service record with no disciplinary, vigilance, or criminal case pending, contemplated, or of satisfactory performance. Tenure of deputation is 3 years per term, subject to satisfactory performance, up to a maximum of 2 terms. No deputation allowance is admissible. On completion of tenure, the officer shall revert to her parent district cadre. Applications received after the last date, incomplete applications, or applications not routed through proper channel shall not be considered. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the mock lecture.

faq.question: Q1. What is WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 is an official notification inviting applications from eligible CDPOs and Supervisors for filling up 13 vacant posts of Instructress and Assistant Instructress on deputation at SIWC Bhubaneswar and SIWC Barpali.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies are notified, comprising 3 Instructress posts and 10 Assistant Instructress posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 25 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the Instructress post?
faq.answer: Regular CDPOs with a minimum of 5 years of experience as CDPO and a Post-Graduation in Nutrition, Home Science, Child Development, Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, or Extension Education are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for the Assistant Instructress post?
faq.answer: Regular Supervisors (ICDS) with a minimum of 5 years of experience as Supervisor and a Post-Graduation in Nutrition, Home Science, Child Development, Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, or Extension Education are eligible.
